Initial release of WeChat Mini App Helper.

- Provides project scaffolding, page generation, component development, API integration, configuration, and deployment tools for WeChat mini programs.
- Includes a command set: scaffold, page, component, api, config, and deploy.
- Outputs primarily in Markdown format for easy copying and editing.
- Suitable for individuals and enterprise users developing WeChat mini apps.
